title: Real ADL P1-02 audit spiral
objective: Have a real Ollama Cloud ADL agent inspect P1-02 and the exact active candidate source using bounded read-only workspace tools; independently verify the current Agent Runner/backend behavior, persist conversation and LocalTrace evidence, correlate a Jaeger projection, and close with independent review. No agent job or source mutation is authorized.

work_items.title: Freeze finding provenance and active candidate identity
deliverables: Finding provenance and candidate fingerprint receipt
done_when: Original P1-02 wording and source are fingerprinted
Active runtime is bound to the current checkout and HEAD
Relevant source hashes and dirty status are recorded
No credentials are read

work_items.title: Run one real, source-grounded audit through the ADL agent
deliverables: Live ADL response with exact source citations, agent/model identity, conversation id and LocalTrace reference
done_when: The response source is Ollama, not a fixture
The agent reads the finding brief and both active-candidate source files through the bounded read tool
The answer distinguishes the original finding from current candidate state and cites line ranges
No file mutation, job or command execution occurs

work_items.title: Probe the active Agent Runner UI and execution endpoint without starting a job
deliverables: Browser/UI and live WebSocket behavior receipt
done_when: Active UI shows execution unavailable and a disabled Run control
WebSocket returns execution_unavailable and close 1008
No job id is created and no execution payload is sent
UI and endpoint observations are bound to PID, checkout and source hashes

work_items.title: Verify durable conversation, LocalTrace and Jaeger correlation
deliverables: API/SQLite/LocalTrace/Jaeger correlation receipt and evidence comparison
done_when: Conversation messages persist and cite the source excerpts
LocalTrace records provider, model, read calls and answer completion
Jaeger projection is correlated and labeled as post-run if applicable
Evidence boundaries and NOT_RUN items are explicit

work_items.title: Independent review and terminal audit verdict
deliverables: Independent review, verdict, limits and terminal gate
done_when: All prior handoffs validate
Real model source-code inspection is distinguished from runtime endpoint validation
P1-02 is classified against the exact target snapshot
No claim is made about source edits or agent job execution
